certified_decoder_import.composition: ROM returns only certified words or zero; synchronous initial reset establishes both response stages, and stall/flush transitions preserve that domain after reset. No instruction-domain assumption is inserted into the admission query.

external_rom_domain_import.initial_pipeline_state: Unconstrained native synchronous-reset registers; no initialization added

certificate_replay.composition: ROM returns only certified words or zero; synchronous initial reset establishes both response stages, and stall/flush transitions preserve that domain after reset. No instruction-domain assumption is inserted into the admission query.

native_word_domain_import.composition: Under initial native reset and the reset-qualified valid-response word domain, base plus induction proves all seven word domains on an overapproximation of original native transitions. Exact original data/control bindings transfer these theorems to the original core; decoder equivalence preserves this outside-decoder state. The immutable zero-fault ROM harness implies the external premise. Adding these already-proved conclusions therefore removes no reachable behavior and can strengthen an unbounded admission proof without adding a new environmental restriction.

datapath_abstraction.soundness_argument: For any original state/input trace, choose each fresh anyseq payload equal to its removed combinational driver's original value at every step. All retained equations and native next-state then agree. Thus every original behavior is included; universal safety on the abstraction implies safety on the original model under the same external environment.
datapath_abstraction.limitations: Counterexamples may be spurious. Arithmetic-value correlations, and optionally branch outcome restrictions, are relaxed. This artifact must not be physically mapped or credited as storage/area savings. No internal occupancy, readiness, fairness or latency premise is added.
